overview: Four apartment towers share a clubhouse centred on work, leisure and well-being. The examples below identify Towers 1 and 2 explicitly; floor plans for later towers should be checked separately.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Islands, Dubai, as identified by the developer project page. The brochure narrative also uses Jumeirah Heights; confirm the registered plot and building on the selected contract.
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises AED 2.2 million and labels this project sold out. This is a historical/portal reference, not an available-unit quotation. Confirm any developer or resale opportunity separately.
research.paymentNote: The primary schedule totals 100%, with 70% payable before completion and 30% on completion. Relative dates and construction triggers must match the selected contract; fees are separate.
research.handoverNote: Q4 2029 is the developer brochure’s anticipated completion, consistent with Property Finder’s December 2029 estimate. It remains a forecast, not confirmed delivery.
